verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials (such as restricted API keys or tokens) for an agent. Related controls exist, including command rules for Codex outside the sandbox, admin access controls, project-scoped MCP configuration, and sign-in flows for websites. These are adjacent permission features, not credential issuance, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
